goal: Prevent intermittent unit test flakiness by reading socket data in a loop until fully received
Ensures socket tests do not assume atomic delivery of payloads across TCP streams
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by reproducing failure with forced chunking and checking the loop fix (Pranav-error)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it eliminates latent flakiness in sock_tests when socket data arrives in chunks
Partial reads are rare in standard loopback CI but fail deterministically under chunked transmission
